separate_from: Previously accepted low-contract and dictionary dependency ports
finding: An unused prepared oracle update could erase later live facts/topology/calls/subscriptions; rejecting only at commit could occur after host alias/root publication.
implementation: Capture actual producer/kernel revision, bind/subscription/call generation, semantic identity, policy, operations and arena references/epochs at preparation entry, before charging callbacks.
Own the requested address mapping and source/normalized-target alias snapshots; charge copy/snapshot visits before cloning.
Recheck constant-time producer/epoch stamps after every charge callback so mutation during a growing source collection aborts before the next clone or iterator advance.
Expose real OraclePreparedUpdate.validate and call it in the actual host immediately before arena/root publication.
Commit rechecks all producer stamps and accepts only unchanged captured source arena or the exact prepared +1 epoch/owned aliases; already committed token replay stays idempotent.

limits: The supported host transaction is serialized; this is not a thread synchronization mechanism.
Generation maintenance covers actual mutating producer services. Deliberate direct mutation of backing dictionaries/private fields outside those services is not an admitted transaction API.
Arena validation guards object aliases and epoch; this receipt does not claim snapshots of every arena field.
